name: xDAI
oneLiner: xDAI is the native gas token of Gnosis Chain, backed 1:1 by USDS bridged through Gnosis bridge infrastructure and inheriting Sky's collateral mix.
collateral: USDS locked or bridged through Gnosis Chain bridge infrastructure, with wrapped WXDAI used for ERC-20 integrations
pegMechanism: Native gas token on Gnosis Chain backed by bridged USDS; users can bridge between USDS and xDAI through official Gnosis bridge routes

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-08-08. Native xDAI balances and the WETH-style WXDAI wrapper expose no local issuer blacklist, freeze, pause, or arbitrary seizure path. The canonical bridge backing is approximately 99% sUSDS plus liquid USDS, however, and those tracked Sky assets carry possible/direct freeze reach. A Sky-side freeze can impair the bridge escrow and xDAI exit path, so the resolved posture is Upstream rather than No even though existing native balances are not directly blacklistable.

mintAuthority.summary: xDAI inherits the upstream USDS issuance path, while Gnosis native-balance minting is separately gated by the xDAI bridge's 4-of-7 validator quorum and daily limits. Distinct 8-of-15 Safes govern the Ethereum and Gnosis bridge proxies, validator sets, limits, and upgrades.

controls.label: Gnosis xDAI bridge validator quorum
controls.capDescription: Four of seven bridge validators can authorize Home Bridge execution, but the bridge enforces a 10,000,000 xDAI daily execution limit and a 10,000,000 xDAI per-transaction maximum observed on Gnosis. The validator quorum cannot raise those governance-set limits.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530288 and Gnosis block 47196992, the bridge validator contracts each reported a 4-of-7 quorum. The Foreign and Home Bridge proxies and their validator contracts were owned by chain-local 8-of-15 Safes with no enabled modules and zero guards. USDS remained the Foreign Bridge daiToken(), and the Home Bridge pointed to the native-balance block reward contract.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: xDAI is a native Gnosis gas balance, not an ERC-20 deployment: USDS enters the canonical Gnosis xDAI Foreign Bridge on Ethereum, a 4-of-7 validator network authorizes the Home Bridge to mint native xDAI through the block reward contract, and the reverse path burns xDAI before USDS is unlocked. This global bridge-representation route has no exact token-contract row to join; WXDAI is only a traded wrapper and is intentionally excluded from canonical supply matching.

protocols.name: Gnosis xDAI Bridge
protocols.note: Canonical Gnosis-native, global-scope bridge representation secured by a 4-of-7 validator network; native xDAI has no ERC-20 contract address for a deployment-row join.

notices.title: Native gas-token supply
notices.message: xDAI is native to Gnosis Chain; the configured contract is listed as a traded wrapper rather than a canonical supply contract.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: xDAI is native bridged supply backed by USDS held through the canonical xDAI bridge rather than collateralized borrowing.
